name: @antiphony/audio-rendition
description: Derives renditions of Antiphony audio blobs (mp3 today) and writes them to R2. The one Antiphony service that is not a Worker: it shells out to ffmpeg, which a Workers runtime cannot do. See specs/archive/cloudflare-migration.md § The ffmpeg problem.

scripts.//dev: Needs a local ffmpeg. The startup probe says whether you have one.
